name: B10-0068/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Jimmy Lai, a 76-year-old Hong Kong newspaper publisher, to be released immediately and without conditions. He was convicted under Hong Kong's National Security Law and could face life in prison. The Parliament says the charges are politically motivated and that his trial was unfair. It also asks the European Union to sanction the officials responsible, to suspend Hong Kong's trade status at the World Trade Organization, and to offer protection to Hong Kong journalists and activists.

- The Parliament asks the EU to sanction Hong Kong and Chinese officials it holds responsible.
- It asks EU countries to stop extraditing people to Hong Kong and China, and to protect journalists and activists.
- It asks the EU to suspend Hong Kong's trade status at the World Trade Organization.
